<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me check which shape the player is currently on by examining adjacency
seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Find player node
w_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] == 1]
player_id = w_nodes[0]['id'] if w_nodes else None
print(f"Player node id: {player_id}")

# Find what the player is adjacent to
adj = seg['adjacency_list']
player_adj = [p for p in adj if p[0] == player_id or p[1] == player_id]
print(f"Player adjacent to: {player_adj}")

# Check the node at player position more carefully
# The player is at (45, 30). Let me see what's around it
# Look for red nodes near (45, 30)
nearby_r = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'R' and 
            any(abs(p[0]-45) <= 1 and abs(p[1]-30) <= 1 for p in n['boundary'])]
print(f"\nRed nodes near player: {[(n['id'], n['pixels'], n['boundary'][:4]) for n in nearby_r]}")

# Let me also check the horizontal line - it seems to connect the two shapes
# Find all red pixels on row 45
row45_r = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'R' and n['boundary'][0][0] == 45]
print(f"\nRed pixels on row 45: {len(row45_r)}")
cols_45 = sorted([n['boundary'][0][1] for n in row45_r])
print(f"Columns: {cols_45}")

# Try SPACE to see what happens
result = action(['SPACE'])
print(f"\nAfter SPACE: board_changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")

# Check player position after SPACE
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
w_nodes2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] == 1]
player_pos2 = w_nodes2[0]['boundary'][0] if w_nodes2 else None
print(f"Player position after SPACE: {player_pos2}")

# Check if any red pixels moved
r_before = set(tuple(n['boundary'][0]) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'R' and n['pixels'] == 1)
r_after = set(tuple(n['boundary'][0]) for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'R' and n['pixels'] == 1)
if r_before != r_after:
    moved = r_after - r_before
    disappeared = r_before - r_after
    print(f"Red pixels changed: {len(moved)} new, {len(disappeared)} gone")
else:
    print("Red pixels unchanged")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
